newsitem.title: USA: Digital to slash prices in servers - source.
newsitem.headline: Digital to slash prices in servers - source.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp will announce Thursday agressive price cuts of as much as 40 percent or more on its servers and workstation computers which run on its 64-bit Alpha chips, according to an industry source.
Digital is making the cuts due to intensified competition within the industry, cost savings due to volume manufacturing and lower prices for memory, the source said.
Prices on servers will be cut worldwide and prices will be cut on workstations in Europe and North America, he said.

Digital has been steadily cutting prices on its Alpha products to compete more effectively with Intel Corp's popular Pentium Pro computer chips. In December, Digital slashed prices on its Alpha microprocessors by up to 50 percent.
